## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you want to add.

## 🎯 Motivation / Use Case

Explain why this feature would be useful. What problem does it solve?

## 📐 Proposed Solution

Describe how you think this feature should be implemented (optional).

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

A clear description of any alternative solutions you've considered.

## 📊 Impact

- [ ] New security check/scanner
- [ ] New Terraform resource
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] New case study
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Other: ___________

## 📎 Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references about the feature request here.
